Class TcoCalculator.Builder

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.tco.TcoCalculator.Builder
Enclosing class:
TcoCalculator
public static final class TcoCalculator.Builder extends Object
Fluent configuration for a TCO comparison, terminated by compare(). Setters validate eagerly (fail-fast IllegalArgumentExceptions), so a mistake surfaces at the call site rather than as a wrong number later.

Defaults: 1000 Mbps bandwidth, EVPL_VC connection type, Term.MONTH_12, egress volume 0 GB, all three archetypes, no Cloud Router, 1 cabinet, 1 cross-connect, 5.0 kW power draw, on-prem inputs from the bundled reference midpoints, and the standard layered rate-card chain (live Equinix pricing, then bundled reference figures).

Currency contract for the onPrem* overrides: caller-supplied values are taken to be in the comparison currency (the currency the egress rates resolved to). The bundled midpoints are published in the reference data's own currency (USD), so when the comparison currency is known to differ, an on-prem archetype still relying on any midpoint is reported unpriced (with the reason) rather than relabelled — supply all four overrides in the comparison currency to price it.

      public TcoCalculator.Builder includeCloudRouter(String packageCode)
      Adds a Fabric Cloud Router of the given package to the Equinix archetype (none is included by default). If the rate card cannot price the package, the archetype is reported as not fully priced with a note naming the missing router — its partial figures stay visible but it is excluded from the recommendation rather than silently under-priced.

      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the package code is null or blank

    • rateCard

      public TcoCalculator.Builder rateCard(RateCard rateCard)
      Sets the rate card that prices every component of the comparison. When omitted, the standard layered chain (RateCard.standardChain(fabric)) applies: live Equinix Fabric pricing first, then the bundled ReferenceRateCard, which also supplies indicative cloud-egress rates. A supplied card replaces that chain entirely; layer it yourself (e.g. RateCard.layered(custom, RateCard.standardChain(fabric))) to keep the defaults as a fallback.
      Parameters:
      rateCard - the rate card to price with, or null to use the standard chain
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining

    • cabinets

      public TcoCalculator.Builder cabinets(int cabinets)
      Sets the number of colocation cabinets for the Equinix-interconnect archetype (default 1). The per-cabinet ColocationItem.CABINET quote — when the rate card prices one — is multiplied by this count.

    • crossConnects

      public TcoCalculator.Builder crossConnects(int crossConnects)
      Sets the number of Equinix cross-connects for the Equinix-interconnect archetype (default 1). The per-unit ColocationItem.CROSS_CONNECT quote (or the reference cross-connect figure when no colocation rate is supplied) is multiplied by this count; zero omits cross-connects entirely.

    • powerKw

      public TcoCalculator.Builder powerKw(double powerKw)
      Sets the power draw in kW (default 5.0). Note the dual use: it scales both the on-prem power/space line (per-kW midpoint × kW) and the Equinix archetype's colocation power line when the rate card prices ColocationItem.POWER_PER_KW — tuning it for one side changes the other.
      Parameters:
      powerKw - the power draw in kW

      this builder for method chaining
      Throws:

    • additionalLineItem

      public TcoCalculator.Builder additionalLineItem(String label, BigDecimal monthly)
      Adds an arbitrary named monthly cost — e.g. compute, storage, or software the rate cards do not price — folded into every priced archetype's breakdown and total. Because it is applied uniformly, it makes the absolute TCO figures realistic without changing which archetype is cheapest (the savings comparison is unaffected). Call multiple times for multiple line items.
      Parameters:
      label - the line-item label shown in each breakdown
      monthly - the monthly amount (in the comparison currency)
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining
